mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_status_histories ( member_id, action, before_status, after_status, reason, processed_by ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{action}, #{beforeStatus}, #{afterStatus}, #{reason}, #{processedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT history.id, history.action, history.before_status, history.after_status, history.reason, processor.name AS processed_by_name, history.processed_at FROM member_status_histories history LEFT JOIN members processor ON processor.id = history.processed_by WHERE history.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY history.processed_at DESC, history.id DESC
